title: Spark Match Repository Governance Manifest (v2)
description: Declarative source of truth for repository ruleset shape across the spark-match org. Consumed by scripts/configure-repo-rulesets.sh. Schema is ADDITIVE: new optional fields are allowed in minor versions; renaming or removing existing fields requires a major version bump.

version.description: Manifest schema version. Must be 2 for this schema.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must match this schema's id suffix.

_note.description: Free-form field documenting decisions or workarounds. Not used by the reconciler; informational only.

defaults.description: Defaults applied to every repo unless overridden. Reconciler must NOT remove existing rules from live state that match defaults, only add missing ones.

adminBypassMode.description: How organization admins bypass rules. 'pull_request' allows admin to bypass within PR context; 'always' allows direct push.

repositories.description: Per-repository overrides. Keys are the repo names within the org.

refs.description: Git ref patterns protected by this repo's ruleset.

reviewerTeam.description: GitHub team slug that owns this repo. Resolved via GET /orgs/{org}/teams/{slug}.

filePatterns.description: File patterns the reviewer team is required for. ['**'] means all files.

statusChecks.description: Required status check contexts (job names). Empty array means no required checks.

extraRefs.description: Optional additional refs to include beyond refs. Deprecated; use refs directly.
